name: budget-meter
title: Budget meter
description: Spend against a limit for a period, with a marker for how much of the period has gone and a straight-line projection you can check by hand.

files.content:
import { judgeBudget, type BudgetInput, type BudgetStatus } from './budget' import { amount } from './permissions' import { cx, formatWhen, pct } from './util' export type BudgetMeterProps = BudgetInput & { title: string className?: string } const WORD: Record = { ok: { word: 'On pace', tone: 'good' }, watch: { word: 'Close to the limit', tone: 'warn' }, 'over-pace': { word: 'Will run out', tone: 'bad' }, over: { word: 'Over the limit', tone: 'bad' }, } /** * Spend against a limit for a period. The marker shows how much of the period has gone, so a bar that is further * along than the marker is ahead of pace. The projection is a straight line you can check with a calculator. */ export function BudgetMeter({ title, className, ...input }: BudgetMeterProps) { const r = judgeBudget(input) const { limit, used, unit } = input const tone = WORD[r.status].tone return (
{title} {WORD[r.status].word}
{amount(used, unit)} of {amount(limit, unit)}

{r.text}

Period
{formatWhen(input.periodStart).slice(0, 10)} to {formatWhen(input.periodEnd).slice(0, 10)}
Gone
{pct(r.elapsedShare, 0)}
Projected
{amount(Math.round(r.projected * 100) / 100, unit)}
{r.runsOutAt &&
Runs out
{formatWhen(r.runsOutAt)}
}
) }
